'''0.26i''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed some crashes and errors.

==Changelog==
* Fixed a bug which caused crashes on 32-bit systems
* Fixed some synchronization errors
* Fixed a bug which caused crashes of all clients in the game associated with sending "bad" input of one of the clients
